what_this_version_is: the exact learner-facing system the fresh human study validates; any change creates a new version requiring a new independent validation set

representation.name: R2
representation.expected_tone_encoding: reference-coded dummies + trajectory x tone interactions

decision_policy.name: POLICY_B_tone_gated
forbidden_outputs: produced-tone diagnosis e.g. T2 instead of T3
decision_policy.retry_semantics: insufficient evidence to confirm; NOT a claim that the production was wrong
decision_policy.score_semantics: internal ranking variable; not a probability, never shown to the learner as a percentage or score

development_evidence.dev_confirmation_note: Dev is not independent; the R2 representation was already inspected on Dev in Phase C6

modification_lock.consequence_of_change: new system version + new independent validation set
